title: City of Syracuse to Close Offices in Observance of Thanksgiving Day
summary: City of Syracuse will close administrative offices on November 26-27, 2026 for Thanksgiving. Trash and recycling collection will shift by one day across the week; Department of Public Works yard waste facility will close; metered parking will be free; emergency services remain available.
processing_notes: Article categorized under 'Traffic & Infrastructure' but content is primarily administrative closure notice
No CIO-specific digital services or IT infrastructure impacts mentioned
SYRCityline app remains operational during office closure; notable digital continuity measure
Author listed as 'Unknown'; published by Office of Communications
